newsitem.title: USA: Former Astra CEO indicted for fraud, tax violations.
newsitem.headline: Former Astra CEO indicted for fraud, tax violations.

text.p: The former Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of a U.S. subsidiary of a Swedish pharmaceutical company was arrested on Wednesday at his Vermont vacation home on fraud and tax evasion charges, officials said.

Lars Bildman, former head of Astra USA, was indicted by a federal grand jury on charges of bilking his company out of $1 million and filing false state and federal tax returns that failed to list company funds he allegedly used to repair his three homes.
Astra USA is a subsidiary of Astra AB, a large Swedish pharmaceutical company. Bildman left the compnay last June.
The indictment, which was unsealed after Bildman's arrest in Killington, Vermont, also charged him with using company funds to pay for trips to Florida and for high-priced prostitutes.
